mapping.draft_py:
# Sylvan Scavenging (FDN), an enchantment (its compiled cast carrier kept, last).
# "At the beginning of your end step, choose one --
#   * Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
#   * Create a 3/3 green Raccoon creature token if you control a creature with power 4 or greater."
# Event: M21 Twinblade Assassins' "At the beginning of your end step" (TurnPhaseEvent END_TURN,
#   actor YOU). Modes: Choose(count 1), chosen as the ability goes on the stack (CR 700.2b).
# Mode 1: M21 Feat of Resistance's B5b-put-counter atom, word for word.
# Mode 2: the token (Elder Gargaroth's create-token, a 3/3 green Raccoon) behind a Conditional, read
#   as the mode resolves: the "if" closes the bullet, so it is no intervening "if" of the trigger.
#   Its predicate is M21 Garruk's Uprising's "if you control a creature with power 4 or greater"
#   (CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 1 over creatures with POWER_GE 4).
end_step = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.END_TURN,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Choose(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        options=(
            A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
                'count': QConst(value=1),
                'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
                'target': Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            }),
            Conditional(
                pred=FAtom(
                    pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE,
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    inner_filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.POWER_GE, count=QConst(value=4)),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                then_effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
                    'count': QConst(value=1),
                    'tokens': TokenSpec(
                        name='Raccoon',
                        type_line='Creature — Raccoon',
                        types=('Creature',),
                        subtypes=('Raccoon',),
                        power=QConst(value=3),
                        toughness=QConst(value=3),
                        keywords=(),
                        abilities=(),
                        colors=('G',),
                    ),
                }),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [end_step, compiled[0]]

clauses.clause: At the beginning of your end step, choose one —
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (end-step trigger, effect Choose count 1); abilities[1] is the enchantment cast carrier

clauses.clause: • Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
• Create a 3/3 green Raccoon creature token if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
clauses.ir: abilities[0].effect.options[1] (Conditional CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 1 creature with power 4 or greater; then CREATE_TOKEN)

mapping.notes: Twinblade Assassins' end-step event (your end step); Choose(count 1): Feat of Resistance's counter on target creature you control; a 3/3 green Raccoon behind a Conditional read on resolution (the 'if' closes the bullet, no intervening if), Garruk's Uprising's 'if you control a creature with power 4 or greater'. Compiled enchantment carrier kept. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: sylvan_scavenging_no_raccoon_without_your_big_creature.
